reason: Half my orders come by call, so this misses them, and recording every call is a hassle. My stock is in my head and my udhaar is in my diary, and both work fine. I don't see rupees coming back into my till.
objection: Phone calls are half my business and it doesn't handle them well. After three months I'd pay 500 rupees a month, and I can't see where that money comes back to me.
would_change_my_mind: If it showed me, on my own customers, that it got back more than 500 rupees a month in udhaar I would have forgotten to collect, and it caught phone orders without me recording anything.
